reading: Recent entertainment scandals may look like a sudden reckoning, but the article argues that they reflect changes set in motion years earlier.
The revelations emerged from journalistic inquiries that had been under way for years.
Such inquiries typically proceed through an initial tip-off, evidence-gathering, corroboration and requests for responses before publication.
The article reports that entertainer Russell Brand was jailed for rape and sexual assault.
It also reports that Married at First Sight UK was cancelled following rape allegations involving the programme.
Walliams and the men accused on Married at First Sight UK deny the allegations against them.
The article traces much of the impetus for women to disclose their experiences to the revelations about Harvey Weinstein and the #MeToo movement.
Seeing action taken can encourage further disclosures by challenging the assumption that reporting abuse achieves nothing.
Unions say that precarious incomes can nevertheless make it difficult for junior freelance workers to raise concerns.
Harriet Wistrich of the Centre for Women's Justice says wealthy or famous people often use legal measures to deter alleged victims from speaking out.
A High Court judge rejected Walliams's request for an injunction to prevent him from being named.
According to the article, ministers have criticised non-disclosure agreements and called for tighter restrictions on their use.
The article reports that a review found no breach of Ofcom's broadcasting code in Channel 4 and production company CPL's handling of the issues raised.
What is increasingly recognised is that senior media executives must help root out abuse, rather than leaving the burden entirely with victims.
Philippa Childs argues that existing internal reporting mechanisms do not adequately serve their purpose.
Wark warns that abuse cannot be dismissed as a legacy of an earlier era and calls for changes within the industry today.
The article ends by asking whether these events could mark a watershed moment for the industry.

vocabulary.definition: A period when people or institutions face serious examination of wrongdoing and pressure to answer for it.
The process of checking whether additional information independently supports an account or claim.
An influence that encourages action or helps a development gather strength.
Uncertain and insufficiently secure, leaving someone vulnerable to an unwelcome change.
To discourage someone from acting by making possible difficulties or consequences seem threatening.
A court order requiring someone to do or stop doing something, here sought to prevent public identification.
Legal agreements requiring people to keep specified information confidential.
To find and eliminate something harmful that has become established within an organisation or system.
A situation or influence that continues because of events or practices from an earlier period.
An event or period marking a decisive change in how a situation develops.

entries.ja: 人や組織が不正行為について厳しく検証され、その責任を取るよう圧力を受ける時期。
entries.ko: 개인이나 기관이 잘못된 행위에 대해 엄중한 검토를 받고 그에 대한 책임을 지라는 압력에 직면하는 시기.
entries.zh-Hans: 个人或机构的过错受到严肃审查，并面临被要求为此负责的压力的一段时期。
entries.es: Periodo en el que personas o instituciones afrontan un examen riguroso de sus actos indebidos y presiones para rendir cuentas por ellos.
entries.pt-BR: Período em que pessoas ou instituições enfrentam uma análise rigorosa de suas condutas indevidas e pressão para prestar contas por elas.
entries.fr: Période durant laquelle des personnes ou des institutions font l’objet d’un examen rigoureux de leurs agissements répréhensibles et subissent des pressions pour en rendre compte.
entries.de: Eine Zeit, in der das Fehlverhalten von Personen oder Institutionen eingehend geprüft wird und diese unter Druck stehen, sich dafür zu verantworten.

entries.ja: 追加の情報が、ある説明や主張を独立した根拠として裏づけているかどうかを確認する過程。
entries.ko: 추가 정보가 어떤 진술이나 주장을 독립적으로 뒷받침하는지 확인하는 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 核查补充信息是否能独立支持某一叙述或说法的过程。
entries.es: Proceso de comprobar si información adicional respalda de manera independiente un relato o una afirmación.
entries.pt-BR: Processo de verificar se informações adicionais sustentam, de forma independente, um relato ou uma afirmação.
entries.fr: Processus consistant à vérifier si des informations supplémentaires appuient de manière indépendante un récit ou une affirmation.
entries.de: Der Vorgang, bei dem geprüft wird, ob zusätzliche Informationen einen Bericht oder eine Behauptung unabhängig stützen.

entries.ja: 行動を促したり、物事の進展に勢いを与えたりする影響。
entries.ko: 행동을 촉진하거나 어떤 변화나 발전에 힘이 실리도록 돕는 영향.
entries.zh-Hans: 促使人们采取行动，或推动某一发展过程势头增强的影响因素。
entries.es: Influencia que impulsa a actuar o ayuda a que un proceso de cambio cobre fuerza.
entries.pt-BR: Influência que incentiva uma ação ou ajuda um processo de mudança a ganhar força.
entries.fr: Influence qui encourage à agir ou aide une évolution à prendre de l’ampleur.
entries.de: Ein Einfluss, der zum Handeln anregt oder einer Entwicklung mehr Schwung verleiht.

entries.ja: 不確かで十分に安定しておらず、望ましくない変化によって困った状況に陥りやすい。
entries.ko: 불확실하고 충분히 안정적이지 않아, 원치 않는 변화가 생기면 어려움에 처하기 쉬운.
entries.zh-Hans: 不确定且缺乏足够保障，使人容易因不利变化而陷入困境的。
entries.es: Incierto y sin suficiente seguridad, de modo que deja a alguien vulnerable ante un cambio desfavorable.
entries.pt-BR: Incerto e sem segurança suficiente, deixando a pessoa vulnerável a uma mudança indesejada.
entries.fr: Incertain et insuffisamment stable, ce qui rend une personne vulnérable à un changement défavorable.
entries.de: Ungewiss und nicht ausreichend abgesichert, sodass jemand bei einer unerwünschten Veränderung leicht in Schwierigkeiten geraten kann.

entries.ja: 起こりうる困難や結果を脅威と感じさせることで、誰かが行動するのを思いとどまらせること。
entries.ko: 발생할 수 있는 어려움이나 결과가 위협적으로 느껴지게 하여 누군가가 행동을 주저하거나 포기하도록 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 使可能出现的困难或后果显得具有威胁性，从而让人不敢或不愿采取行动。
entries.es: Disuadir a alguien de actuar haciendo que las posibles dificultades o consecuencias parezcan amenazantes.
entries.pt-BR: Desencorajar alguém a agir, fazendo com que possíveis dificuldades ou consequências pareçam ameaçadoras.
entries.fr: Décourager quelqu’un d’agir en faisant paraître menaçantes les difficultés ou les conséquences possibles.
entries.de: Jemanden vom Handeln abhalten, indem mögliche Schwierigkeiten oder Folgen bedrohlich erscheinen.

entries.ja: 何かを行う、またはやめるよう命じる裁判所の命令。ここでは、誰であるかを公に明かされないようにするために求められたもの。
entries.ko: 누군가에게 어떤 일을 하거나 중단하도록 요구하는 법원의 명령. 여기서는 신원이 공개되는 것을 막기 위해 신청한 명령을 말한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 法院要求某人做某事或停止做某事的命令；这里指为阻止身份被公开而申请的命令。
entries.es: Orden judicial que exige a alguien hacer algo o dejar de hacerlo; aquí se solicitó para impedir que se revelara públicamente su identidad.
entries.pt-BR: Ordem judicial que exige que alguém faça algo ou deixe de fazê-lo; aqui, foi solicitada para impedir a divulgação pública de sua identidade.
entries.fr: Ordre d’un tribunal imposant à quelqu’un de faire quelque chose ou de cesser de le faire ; ici, il a été demandé pour empêcher que son identité soit rendue publique.
entries.de: Eine gerichtliche Anordnung, die jemanden verpflichtet, etwas zu tun oder zu unterlassen; hier wurde sie beantragt, um die öffentliche Bekanntgabe der Identität zu verhindern.

entries.ja: 指定された情報を秘密にしておくことを当事者に義務づける法的な合意。
entries.ko: 특정 정보를 비밀로 유지하도록 당사자에게 의무를 부과하는 법적 합의.
entries.zh-Hans: 要求相关人员对指定信息保密的法律协议。
entries.es: Acuerdos legales que obligan a las personas a mantener confidencial determinada información.
entries.pt-BR: Acordos legais que obrigam as pessoas a manter determinadas informações em sigilo.
entries.fr: Accords juridiques obligeant les personnes concernées à garder certaines informations confidentielles.
entries.de: Rechtliche Vereinbarungen, die Personen dazu verpflichten, bestimmte Informationen vertraulich zu behandeln.

entries.ja: 組織や仕組みの中に根づいた有害なものを見つけ出し、取り除くこと。
entries.ko: 조직이나 체계 안에 자리 잡은 해로운 것을 찾아내어 없애는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 找出并清除已在某个组织或体系中扎根的有害事物。
entries.es: Detectar y eliminar algo perjudicial que se ha arraigado en una organización o un sistema.
entries.pt-BR: Identificar e eliminar algo prejudicial que se enraizou em uma organização ou sistema.
entries.fr: Repérer et éliminer quelque chose de nuisible qui s’est installé dans une organisation ou un système.
entries.de: Etwas Schädliches, das sich in einer Organisation oder einem System festgesetzt hat, aufspüren und beseitigen.

entries.ja: 過去の出来事や慣行が原因で、現在も続いている状況や影響。
entries.ko: 과거의 사건이나 관행 때문에 지금까지 이어지는 상황이나 영향.
entries.zh-Hans: 因过去的事件或做法而延续至今的状况或影响。
entries.es: Situación o influencia que perdura debido a hechos o prácticas de una época anterior.
entries.pt-BR: Situação ou influência que permanece em razão de acontecimentos ou práticas de uma época anterior.
entries.fr: Situation ou influence qui perdure en raison d’événements ou de pratiques d’une époque antérieure.
entries.de: Eine Situation oder ein Einfluss, der aufgrund von Ereignissen oder Praktiken aus einer früheren Zeit fortbesteht.

entries.ja: 状況の展開に決定的な変化が生じる節目となる出来事や時期。
entries.ko: 상황이 전개되는 방식에 결정적인 변화가 일어나는 계기가 되는 사건이나 시기.
entries.zh-Hans: 标志着局势发展方式发生决定性变化的事件或时期。
entries.es: Acontecimiento o periodo que marca un cambio decisivo en el rumbo de una situación.
entries.pt-BR: Acontecimento ou período que marca uma mudança decisiva no rumo de uma situação.
entries.fr: Événement ou période qui marque un changement décisif dans l’évolution d’une situation.
entries.de: Ein Ereignis oder Zeitraum, der eine entscheidende Veränderung im Verlauf einer Situation markiert.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
